picker.title: Choose a dog for {{name}}
picker.intro: Your choice shapes what caring for the dog will be like — just like with a real dog.

free.title: Free mixed breed
free.hint: Free forever. All the care and game rules, without the 12-week programme or a certificate; history of the last 7 days. The dog is always a mixed breed.

challenge.title: 12-week challenge — {{price}}
challenge.hint: The programme that shows whether your child is ready for a dog, with a paid breed of your choice, a certificate and the full history. The challenge starts with a purchase: the dog waits until you buy it for this dog (also possible before the contract is signed). One-time payment, no subscription. Want to try first? Choose the free mixed breed.
